lines.en: I decide that there's no better way to spend the morning than by visiting a mischievous girl who I can't quite understand.
lines.zh: 我觉得，没有比去见一个我怎么也看不透的淘气女孩更好的方式来消磨这个早晨了。

lines.en: And while that might seem like a strange way to start the day, it's actually kind of nice.
lines.zh: 虽然这听起来像是个奇怪的开场，但其实还挺不错的。

lines.en: Kirin's extremely...unreserved way of speaking is a nice change of pace and almost even exciting by some standards.
lines.zh: Kirin 那种极度……口无遮拦的说话方式让人耳目一新，按某些标准甚至算得上刺激。

lines.en: The two of us sit on the sidelines and watch the rest of the girls practice as she points out and tells me secrets about each one.
lines.zh: 我们俩坐在场边看其他女孩训练，她一边指指点点，一边把每个人的秘密抖给我听。

lines.en: At first, I think it's a little strange that she knows so much, but I ultimately chalk it up to her just being on good terms with everyone.
lines.zh: 起初我觉得她知道这么多有点奇怪，但最后我把它归结为她跟大家关系都好。

lines.en: Miku and Karin eventually catch on to the fact that Kirin is trying to slack off and they forcibly drag her on to the field to practice.
lines.zh: Miku 和 Karin 终于察觉 Kirin 在偷懒，硬把她拖上场去训练。

lines.en: I'm a little surprised to see that she's actually quite good at soccer when she tries to be.
lines.zh: 我有点惊讶地发现，只要她肯认真，足球其实踢得相当好。

lines.en: It just seems like she never really {i}wants{/i} to try in the first place...
lines.zh: 只是她似乎打从一开始就根本不{i}想{/i}努力……
